# headroom-stats-plugin — combined document

Live token/cost-savings dashboard for the Headroom compression proxy inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI.

- Repository: https://github.com/Zenjibad/headroom-stats-plugin (public, MIT, topic `dsh-plugin`)
- Human docs: [README.md](README.md) (English) · [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) (中文)
- Agent guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Source: [package-source.js](package-source.js)

## What it does

Two UI seats backed by one 5s poller, showing stats from headroom's `proxy_savings.json`:

- **Settings → Headroom Stats** (`settings.section`, id `headroom-stats`): lifetime KPI cards (tokens saved, compression $, cache $, requests), current-session card, cache-vs-compression proportional bar, top-10 projects table, loading/error/stale states.
- **Composer stats line** (`conversation.composer.dock`, id `headroom-dock`): `Headroom: 11.4M tokens saved · $26.23 · 11.2% this session`; renders nothing when data is missing.

## How it works

1. Host half (DSH process) probes env once via the `subprocess` service: `cmd /c echo %HEADROOM_SAVINGS_PATH%&echo %HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR%&echo %USERPROFILE%` (DSH host sandbox exposes no direct env access; unexpanded `%VAR%` literals are treated as null).
2. Path candidates in order: `HEADROOM_SAVINGS_PATH` → `HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR`/`proxy_savings.json` → `%USERPROFILE%\.headroom\proxy_savings.json`. First existing wins. No hardcoded paths — shareable across machines.
3. `fs` service: `stat` then `readText`, `JSON.parse`, reshape snake_case → camelCase (`projects` is an OBJECT keyed by name — converted to array, sorted desc by tokensSaved, top 10). Exposes `harness.handle('getStats')`.
4. Client half: single `ctx.interval` 5s poller → `host.call('getStats')` → snapshot fan-out to both seats via a listeners set. Pure pull; never throws across RPC (`{ok:false,error}` on failure).

## Configuration

No config file, no persisted settings. Env vars (read once, cached):

| Variable | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `HEADROOM_SAVINGS_PATH` | absolute path to `proxy_savings.json` (highest priority) |
| `HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR` | headroom workspace override (appended `/proxy_savings.json`) |
| `%USERPROFILE%` | fallback: `%USERPROFILE%\.headroom\proxy_savings.json` |

Poll interval: 5s constant (`ctx.interval(poll, 5000)` in the Client half).

## Install (dynamic only)

This plugin is dynamic-only: the Client UI must register in the runtime registry, so there is no static `cordis.patch.yml` and no `dsh.bundle` manifest.

1. `cordis_define` — paste `host`/`client` strings from `package-source.js` into `code.host`/`code.client` (`plugin.idPrefix: 'hstt'`, `name: 'headroom-stats'`).
2. `cordis_run` the Package; approve the Client Package in the GUI on first run.
3. Stop: `cordis_stop`. Remove: `cordis_undefine`. Re-runs need no further approval.

## Key behaviors

- Read-only: never writes to the headroom directory; no network.
- Single poller feeding both seats (no duplicate reads).
- Dynamic path detection — never hardcode user paths.
- Theme tokens only (`--dsw-alias-*`) in client CSS; font comes from seat-wrapper inheritance (do not set font-family).
- `getStats` never throws; missing/unparseable file → unavailable state, self-recovers ≤5s.

## Probed environment facts

- DSH host sandbox: no `process`, `os`, or env access — env via `subprocess` (`cmd /c echo %VAR%`, collect-mode stdout, `handle.collected.stdout.readFrom(0)` after `handle.done`).
- `fs.resolve` does not expand `~` or `${VAR}`; absolute Windows paths work.
- `FsInfo` has no mtime (`version`, `type`, `size`) — re-read every poll.
- `Date` is not a host builtin — snapshot carries no server timestamp.
- Dynamic Tool definitions: `parameters` key (not `inputSchema`), `output: {schema, render}`, `output.schema.additionalProperties` explicit.

## Testing

- Runtime: `cordis_inspect_self(pluginId, packageId)` — host running with `getStats` handler, client running.
- Slots: `Slots.listSubTree` root `settings.section` (occupant `headroom-stats`) and `conversation.composer.dock` (occupant `headroom-dock`).
- Failure path: temporarily rename `~/.headroom/proxy_savings.json` — settings shows unavailable, dock hides; restore → recovers ≤5s.
- Fixture: `tests/fixtures/proxy_savings.json` is a point-in-time snapshot (the live file grows continuously — numeric comparison against the live file at review time is invalid by design).

## Repository layout

- `package-source.js` — authoritative plugin source (host+client strings, mirrors the registry Package)
- `docs/design.md`, `docs/plan.md` — design spec + implementation plan
- `tests/fixtures/proxy_savings.json` — real-shape snapshot
- `AGENTS.md` — agent guide
- `README.md`, `README.zh.md` — bilingual docs (en default, zh)
- `package.json` — npm metadata (no `dsh.bundle`)
